# About this document

This source renders once for each of the eight cover themes. The
theme is set in the format block of a per-theme metadata file:

```yaml
format:
  obsidian-pdf:
    titlepage: banded-slate
```

`tools/render-covers.sh` produces all eight PDFs into
`examples/covers/`.

| Theme | Cover |
|---|---|
| `plain` | classification, logo, title, author, date, identity line |
| `formal` | centred, heavier title; report cover |
| `classic-lined` | rules above and below the title |
| `colorbox` | title in a filled box |
| `academic` | journal-style author and affiliation machinery |
| `bg-image` | background image behind the content (the showcase uses the bundled corner motif, `corner-bg.png`) |
| `banded` | full-page maroon band, gold rule, white title block |
| `banded-slate` | full-page slate band, yellow rule, white title block |

## The house cover

The default (no `titlepage:` key) is the clean monochrome cover:
near-black title on white, classification top-right, identity line
at the bottom.

## Custom covers

Any theme value can be tuned through `titlepage-theme:` (alignment,
font sizes, colours, spacing), and `titlepage: <file.tex>` includes
a custom LaTeX cover file. See docs/reference.md for the full field
catalogue.

## Body content

This section exists so the rendered documents have a body page
after the cover. The classification marking, running header, page
numbers, and identity footer are the same across every theme.
